groups.title: Convert documents
groups.summary: Turn Office files, PDFs, HTML and Markdown into other formats. You see what changed before you download.

groups.title: Work with PDFs
groups.summary: Inspect, organize, compress and secure PDFs. Every tool saves a new file and leaves your original alone.

groups.title: Inspect and clean
groups.summary: Find hidden origin labels and invisible characters, and save a copy without them.

tools.title: Word to PDF
tools.summary: Turn a Word document into a PDF. You'll see each page and anything that didn't convert exactly before you download.
tools.seoTitle: Word to PDF in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert a Word document to PDF in your browser. Review the page preview and conversion warnings, then download a copy without uploading your file.

choices.label: Standard
choices.hint: Best for sharing and printing. Fonts are embedded.

choices.label: Accessible
choices.hint: Tagged so screen readers can follow headings and tables.

choices.label: Reproducible
choices.hint: The same file every time, for build pipelines and tests.

options.label: Also create a layout check image of page 1
options.hint: Outlines words, lines and reading order. Useful when reporting a layout problem.

tools.expect: Text, tables, images, headers, footers, lists and page settings come across. Complex floating layout, SmartArt, fields and exact Word page breaks can differ.

tools.title: Excel to PDF
tools.summary: Turn an Excel workbook into a PDF, with each sheet laid out on pages and any changes listed.
tools.seoTitle: Excel to PDF in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert Excel workbooks to PDF in your browser. Review sheet layouts and conversion warnings, then download the PDF without uploading your workbook.

choices.label: Whole workbook
choices.hint: Keeps page layout, images and every row.

choices.label: Quick preview
choices.hint: First 250 rows of each sheet, without images or page layout. Faster for big files.

choices.label: Accessible
choices.hint: Tagged so screen readers can follow the tables.

tools.expect: Very large or image-heavy workbooks are better converted with Quick preview here, or with the .NET library on a server.

tools.title: PowerPoint to PDF
tools.summary: Turn slides into a PDF and check any slide that couldn't be reproduced exactly.
tools.seoTitle: PowerPoint to PDF in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert PowerPoint slides to PDF in your browser. Review the page preview and any conversion warnings before downloading a copy of your presentation.
tools.expect: Animations, transitions and video don't exist in a PDF. Some advanced shape effects are simplified.

tools.title: HTML to PDF
tools.summary: Paste HTML and CSS, or open an .html file, and get an accessible PDF.
tools.seoTitle: HTML to PDF in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert an HTML file or pasted HTML and CSS to PDF in your browser. Review the page preview and download the result without uploading your content.

input.label: HTML
input.sampleText:
Quarterly update

A short report with headings, a list and a table.

  • Revenue up 12%
  • Two new regions
RegionSales
North1,200
South980

tools.expect: Scripts don't run, and pages aren't fetched from the internet. Most layout CSS works; anything unsupported is listed.

tools.title: Markdown to HTML
tools.summary: Type or paste Markdown and see the web page as you go. Copy the HTML or download it.
tools.seoTitle: Markdown to HTML in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert Markdown to HTML as you type in your browser. Preview headings, lists and tables, then copy the HTML or download the generated web page.

input.label: Markdown
input.sampleText:
# Release notes

This **Markdown** turns into a web page as you type.

| Feature | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Tables | Supported |
| Task lists | Supported |

- [x] Runs in your browser
- [ ] Uploads anything

tools.expect: Raw HTML inside the Markdown is removed or simplified for safety.

tools.title: HTML to Markdown
tools.summary: Turn a web page or an HTML snippet into clean Markdown. Anything that can't be kept is listed.
tools.seoTitle: HTML to Markdown in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert an HTML file or snippet to Markdown in your browser. Review any content that could not be preserved, then copy or download the Markdown.

input.label: HTML
input.sampleText:
Getting started

Install the package, then call Convert.

  1. Install
  2. Convert
  3. Review warnings

See the documentation.

tools.expect: Page layout, styling, scripts and forms have no Markdown equivalent and are dropped.

tools.title: Markdown to Word
tools.summary: Create an editable Word document from Markdown, with real headings, lists and tables.
tools.seoTitle: Markdown to Word in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert Markdown into an editable Word document with headings, lists and tables. Review the result and download the DOCX directly in your browser.

input.label: Markdown
input.sampleText:
# Project brief

## Goals

- Ship the browser tools
- Keep files on the device

## Timeline

| Phase | Weeks |
| --- | --- |
| Build | 3 |
| Review | 1 |

tools.expect: Markdown has no page layout, so the document uses a clean default style.

tools.title: PDF to Word
tools.summary: Get an editable Word document from a PDF's text, tables, links and images.
tools.seoTitle: PDF to Word in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert a PDF to an editable Word document in your browser. Review the conversion report and download the DOCX without uploading the original file.
tools.expect: A PDF stores where things sit on a page, not the original document. Columns, fonts and complex graphics can come out differently. Scanned pages need OCR, which this tool doesn't do.

tools.title: PDF tables to Excel
tools.summary: Find the tables in a PDF and put their rows and columns into an Excel workbook.
tools.seoTitle: PDF tables to Excel in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Extract tables from a PDF into an Excel workbook in your browser. Review the detected rows and columns, then download the workbook without uploads.
tools.expect: Only detected tables are copied, not the rest of the page. Scanned pages need OCR.

tools.title: PDF to PowerPoint
tools.summary: Turn each PDF page into a slide. Choose editable content or an exact picture of each page.
tools.seoTitle: PDF to PowerPoint in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert PDF pages into PowerPoint slides in your browser. Choose editable content or page images, review the report and download the presentation.

choices.label: Editable
choices.hint: Text, tables and shapes you can change. Layout can shift.

choices.label: Exact picture
choices.hint: Each page looks exactly right, but nothing is editable.

choices.label: Picture + editable tables
choices.hint: Exact page picture with tables you can edit on top.

choices.label: Tables only
choices.hint: Just the detected tables, one per slide.

tools.expect: A PDF doesn't contain the original slides, animations or transitions.

tools.title: PDF to HTML
tools.summary: Turn a PDF into a web page that keeps each page's layout, for reviewing and sharing.
tools.seoTitle: PDF to HTML in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert a PDF to HTML that preserves its page layout for review and sharing. Preview the result and download the web page directly in your browser.
tools.expect: Text from scanned pages isn't recognised, and the result is for reading, not for editing the original.

tools.title: PDF to images
tools.summary: Save every PDF page as a PNG image. Several pages come as one ZIP file.
tools.seoTitle: PDF to PNG images in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Convert each PDF page to a PNG image in your browser. Review the page previews and download a single image or a ZIP containing all generated pages.
tools.expect: Images can't be searched or edited as text. Very large PDFs may hit the browser's memory limit.

tools.title: Inspect PDF
tools.summary: See what's inside a PDF: pages, version, password, forms, signatures and scripts. Nothing is changed.
tools.seoTitle: Inspect a PDF online in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Inspect PDF pages, passwords, forms, signatures and scripts in your browser. Read the document report without changing or uploading the original file.
tools.expect: This reads the file only. It doesn't check who signed it or remove passwords.

tools.title: Compare PDFs
tools.summary: Put two versions of a PDF side by side and see exactly what changed on each page.
tools.seoTitle: Compare two PDFs online in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Compare two PDFs side by side in your browser. Review page images, visual differences and structural findings without uploading either document.
tools.expect: Up to 25 pages are compared pixel by pixel. A difference tells you where to look, not which version is right.

tools.title: Merge PDFs
tools.summary: Combine 2 to 10 PDFs into one, in the order you choose.
tools.seoTitle: Merge PDFs online in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Merge two to ten PDFs in your browser, in the order you choose. Review the combined document and download a new PDF while keeping the original files.
tools.expect: Bookmarks, forms and signatures from separate files may not carry over cleanly into one document.

tools.title: Split PDF
tools.summary: Cut a PDF into smaller PDFs with the same number of pages each.
tools.seoTitle: Split a PDF online in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Split a PDF into separate files in your browser. Review the result and download the extracted pages together in a ZIP without uploading your document.
tools.expect: The parts come as one ZIP file, up to 100 parts.

tools.title: Extract pages
tools.summary: Pick the pages you want and save them as a new PDF.
tools.seoTitle: Extract PDF pages online | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Extract selected pages from a PDF in your browser. Choose page numbers or ranges, review the new document and download a copy containing those pages.
tools.expect: Pages keep their content exactly; only the page list changes.

tools.title: Delete pages
tools.summary: Pick the pages to remove and save a copy without them.
tools.seoTitle: Delete PDF pages online | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Delete selected pages from a PDF in your browser. Review the remaining pages and download a new copy while keeping your original document unchanged.
tools.expect: Only the copy changes. To keep a few pages instead, use Extract pages.

tools.title: Reorder pages
tools.summary: Drag pages into a new order and save the result.
tools.seoTitle: Reorder PDF pages online | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Reorder PDF pages in your browser by entering the page sequence you want. Review the new order and download a copy while keeping the original file.
tools.expect: Every page is kept exactly once.

tools.title: Rotate pages
tools.summary: Turn sideways or upside-down pages the right way round.
tools.seoTitle: Rotate PDF pages online | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Rotate selected PDF pages in your browser. Choose the pages and rotation, review the result and download a copy without changing the original file.
tools.expect: This turns whole pages. It doesn't straighten a slightly tilted scan.

tools.title: Compress PDF
tools.summary: Make a PDF smaller without lowering its quality. You'll see the size before and after.
tools.seoTitle: Compress a PDF without losing quality | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Compress a PDF in your browser without lowering its quality. Compare the original and result sizes, review the report and download the smaller copy.

choices.label: Fast web view
choices.hint: Opens page by page while downloading.

choices.label: Careful
choices.hint: Only the most conservative changes, for archives.

tools.expect: Images aren't recompressed and pages aren't turned into pictures, so already-compact PDFs may not get smaller.

tools.title: Protect PDF
tools.summary: Add a password to a PDF. It uses AES-256 encryption.
tools.seoTitle: Password protect a PDF in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Protect a PDF with a password in your browser using AES-256 encryption. Download the protected copy without uploading your document or password.

options.label: Separate password for changing permissions
options.hint: Leave empty to use the same password.

tools.expect: Write the password down. Nobody, including OfficeIMO, can recover it. A password isn't a digital signature.

tools.title: Unlock PDF
tools.summary: Remove the password from a PDF you have the password for.
tools.seoTitle: Remove a PDF password in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Unlock a PDF in your browser using its current password. Review the result and download a copy without password protection while keeping the original.

input.label: PDF
input.sampleNote: The sample's password is officeimo-sample. It's filled in for you.

options.label: PDF password
options.hint: If the PDF has separate open and permissions passwords, use the permissions password.

tools.expect: You need the real password; this doesn't break or bypass protection. Certificate-based protection isn't supported.

tools.title: Redact PDF text
tools.summary: Find text such as a name or number, check every match, then remove it from a copy for good.
tools.seoTitle: Redact PDF text online | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Find PDF text, review every match and remove it from a new copy in your browser. Verify the result before downloading without uploading your document.

options.label: Text to remove
options.placeholder: For example a name or account number

run.label: Find matches
run.confirmLabel: Remove matches and save a copy

tools.expect: Matching ignores upper and lower case. Text inside images, and scanned pages, can't be found.

tools.title: Check and remove file origin data
tools.summary: Find Content Credentials and AI source labels hidden in an image, PDF or Office file, and save a copy without them.
tools.seoTitle: Inspect file provenance in your browser | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Inspect Content Credentials and AI source labels in images, PDFs and Office files. Review the records and save a cleaned copy directly in your browser.

input.label: image, PDF or Office file
input.sampleNote: The sample's AI source label is test data added for this demo.

run.label: Check again
run.confirmLabel: Remove selected and save a copy

tools.expect: Visible watermarks, image pixels and other metadata such as camera details stay as they are. The check can't prove whether a file was made by AI.

tools.title: Find hidden characters in text
tools.summary: Spot invisible and direction-changing characters in pasted text or a text file, and remove the ones you don't want.
tools.seoTitle: Find invisible Unicode characters in text | OfficeIMO
tools.seoDescription: Inspect pasted text or a text file for invisible and direction-changing characters in your browser. Review matches and remove only the selected kinds.

input.label: text
input.sampleText:
Invoice‮123‬
Language joiner: a‍b
Emoji: ❤️
Non-breaking space: hello world

run.label: Check again
run.confirmLabel: Remove selected and save a copy

tools.expect: Text files up to 1 MB, or up to 1,048,576 pasted characters. Some characters are intentional, such as joiners inside emoji, so nothing is selected for you.
